resources.name: Colorado Legal Services – Southeastern Colorado (Pueblo Office)
services: Eviction defense and housing stability clinics
Protection orders and family safety filings

contact.address: 1000 W. 6th St., Suite I, Pueblo, CO 81003

resources.eligibility: Income- and asset-screened Pueblo/Southeastern Colorado residents; priority for survivors of violence, seniors, and people at risk of homelessness.

resources.name: Posada Pueblo
services: Emergency motel vouchers and diversion support
resources.eligibility: Households or individuals experiencing or at risk of homelessness in Pueblo County; bilingual staff available.

resources.name: YWCA Pueblo Domestic Violence Program
services: Emergency shelter beds and hotel placements
Civil legal advocacy and court accompaniment
resources.eligibility: Survivors of domestic violence and their dependents regardless of gender; capacity-based shelter placements.

resources.name: Rape Crisis Services of Pueblo
resources.eligibility: Survivors and secondary survivors in Pueblo and surrounding counties; Spanish-speaking advocates available.

resources.name: Health Solutions Crisis Walk-In Center
services: Mobile crisis response and peer support
resources.eligibility: No-cost crisis care regardless of insurance; serves youth and adults across Pueblo County.

resources.name: Colorado Rapid Response Network (CORRN)
services: Statewide hotline (844-864-8341 opt.1 live / opt.2 past incidents)
Dispatch of trained observers and legal support teams
Incident logging shared with immigrant-rights coalitions
resources.eligibility: Anyone witnessing immigration enforcement activity in Colorado; bilingual dispatch available.

resources.name: Rocky Mountain Immigrant Advocacy Network (RMIAN)
services: Legal orientation for detained adults at Aurora GEO
Child advocacy program for unaccompanied minors
Social service coordination for released families
resources.eligibility: Colorado families with detained adults or minors; need A-number and detention location.

resources.name: Colorado Crisis Services
services: Referrals to local walk-in centers and peer support
resources.eligibility: Open to anyone in Colorado regardless of insurance or immigration status; translation available.

resources.name: Catholic Charities of Pueblo
resources.eligibility: Income-qualified families following Head Start guidelines; bilingual staff available.

resources.name: Pueblo City-County Library District TechConnect
services: Digital literacy classes and drop-in tech help
resources.eligibility: Library card required; device loans typically 21 days.

resources.name: Pueblo Cooperative Care Center
services: Mail service and limited utility assistance referrals
resources.eligibility: Pueblo County residents; IDs requested but emergency support available.
